nodes.speaker: Gardener
nodes.text: Oh, hello! Watch your step — the plants here grow fast when you tend to them every day.

nodes.speaker: Gardener
text: Rootine is a habit and routine tracker. You plant habits like seeds and watch them grow with consistency.
It's about building small daily routines that compound over time. The garden metaphor isn't just decoration — it's the whole philosophy.

nodes.speaker: Gardener
nodes.text: The portal to Rootine is over by the tall fern on the right. Owner access needed — your garden is personal.

nodes.speaker: Gardener
nodes.text: Enjoy the greenery! Each plant represents a different habit. The portal is on the right whenever you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Gardener
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Remember — consistency is everything!
